IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: kv-prefix-eviction-panic -> elevated 502/504 + gateway timeouts observed across prod clusters in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. PD alert -> 3532109876
Ava (oncall): getting alerts, p50/p99 latency for /v1/chat backends spiking. 502 and 504 mostly, occasional 500s. Dashboards show prefix cache eviction ops per-shard jumping, read-through misses up.
Miguel (sre): grabbing logs and tracing. Any sign of customer impact magnitude?
Support-Triage: two major accounts reported failures for >3min, multiple support tickets. We've added customers to incident.
Rina (runtime): logs show repetitive shard checksum validation failures during rehydrate:
```
WARN prefix_shard shard=117 rehydrate failed err=checksum_mismatch expected=0x1f2a got=0x1f20
INFO prefix_cache evict op=panic shard=117 cause=corrupt-entry
```
Plus lots of KV connection churn post-evict. Looks like an on-disk corruption detection triggered eviction, which then caused hot re-fetches and client saturation.
Ava (oncall): that explains the miss storm. Short mitigation brainstorm: 1) make affected prefix shards read-only / bypass eviction, 2) disable async prefetch, 3) enable fast-fail routing to fallback-llm for high-error routes. Thoughts?
Rina (runtime): agree. I'll push a runtime patch to: set prefix_shard.eviction_hysteresis=10s, disable prefetch on affected shard groups, and enable soft-validate (skip eviction on single checksum mismatch). Patch snippet:
```
--prefix-prefetch.enabled=false
--prefix-evict.hysteresis=10000
--prefix-validate.mode=warn-not-evict
```
Miguel (sre): I'll flip gateway circuit-breaker to route-to:backup for /v1/chat for 20% traffic and set max_inflight per-client to reduce backend pressure. Command:
```
POST /admin/cb {"route":"/v1/chat","action":"route_to:backup","pct":20}
```
IncidentBot: Escalation: After 5m of mitigation global 5xx dropped 28% but customer error counts still elevated in eu-west-1. SEV-2 declared.
Ava (oncall): rolling the runtime patch to canary-1 (5% traffic) now. Rina, monitor checksum logs and eviction rate. Miguel, watch gateway error rates and customer tickets.
Rina (runtime): canary-1 deployed. Early telemetry: eviction ops for shards in canary down ~55%, checksum WARNs still present but not causing evict. 5xx on that slice down 40%. Holding 5m.
Support-Triage: one customer in eu-west saw partial recovery; others still noisy. Sending update to affected customers with mitigation steps (rate limits + retry guidance).
Miguel (sre): after hysteresis change, KV client reconnection spikes reduced. However, we see elevated read latency due to bypass (cold reads). To limit regressions, I'll temporarily scale dedicated KV clients in eu-west by +30% and enable read-cache TTL=2s to smooth spikes.
Ava (oncall): good. Also please disable automatic eviction retries for 30m to avoid tight re-evict loops. Command applied.
Rina (runtime): promoting to canary-2 (25%). Monitoring shows region-level improvements; eu-west still lagging but trending. Checksum mismatch events are down 85% post-change.
IncidentBot: After 20m mitigations reduced global 5xx by ~60%. Paging will remain until follow-up action items created.
Miguel (sre): temporary mitigations summary posted to runbook channel. Next steps: full data integrity check on affected KV nodes, validate compact/gc windows, and a rollback plan if needed. I'll open a ticket for KVMaintenance.
Ava (oncall): immediate customer comms: 14:02 UTC first errors, 14:08 UTC mitigation actions (circuit-breaker + bypass), 14:15 UTC canary start, 14:32 UTC broad mitigations showing improvement.
Support-Triage: confirming customers notified and given ETA for postmortem.
Rina (runtime): postmortem owner assigned to me. I'll collect logs, reproduce locally with shard-sim, and propose code changes: more conservative eviction policy, stronger checksum repair flow, and prefetch backoff. Also will add targeted alerts for checksum drift per-shard.
Miguel (sre): handoff: I'm staying on infra follow-up (KV node checks and autoscaling adjustments). Ava, you can handoff oncall to Rina.
Ava (oncall): handing off to Rina. Notes left in incident doc: mitigations active (hysteresis, prefetch disabled, circuit-breakers), scaling adjustments in eu-west, customer notifications sent. Paging cleared at 14:50 UTC but we keep the incident open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Paging cleared. Ongoing follow-up in #postmortems.
Rina (runtime): I'll open the postmortem ticket and link traces and runbook steps. Thanks team.
